narrative.title: Advancing a Licensing Key by One Arrangement
narrative.scenario: A license generator walks through every arrangement of a fixed set of key segments in lexicographic order, one arrangement per issued license. Given the arrangement currently in use, produce the very next one. If the current arrangement is already the largest possible, wrap around to the smallest arrangement instead.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n integers representing the current arrangement.
narrative.outputFormat: The same array mutated in place into the next lexicographically greater arrangement, or into ascending order when no greater arrangement exists.
constraints: The rearrangement must be in place with constant extra memory

testCases.explanation: Swapping the final pair gives the smallest arrangement larger than 1,2,3.
The arrangement is already the largest, so the key wraps around to ascending order.

hintLevels: Level 1: Only the longest suffix that never rises needs attention; everything before the pivot is already fixed.
Level 2: Find the rightmost position whose value is smaller than its right neighbour, swap it with the smallest larger value to its right, then reverse the part after that pivot.
Level 3: When no such position exists the arrangement is maximal and the whole array must be reversed, and the reversal has to start at pivot+1 even if the pivot is index -1.
